news.title:
DCB Bank sets June 12, 2026, as the record date for Rs.1.45/share dividend.
Dividend approval is subject to AGM decisions and tax deductions per IT Act 2025.

Private banks outperformed PSBs in Q4 FY26, with stabilizing NIMs, robust NII growth, and improving asset quality.
Axis Bank, Karur Vysya Bank, and DCB Bank favored; SBI and IDFC First Bank face earnings downgrades due to yield pressures.
DCBBANK: Upcoming Results And Governance Changes Will Support More Optimistic Medium Term View
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target on DCB Bank from ₹211.82 to ₹228.24, citing slightly revised assumptions around growth, profitability and forward P/E that support a higher fair value estimate. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on April 24, 2026 to consider the audited financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, a potential dividend recommendation, and possible fund or capital raising plans.

news.title: DCBBANK: Board Rotation And Dividend Plans Will Guide Fair Prospects
news.body: Analysts have raised their price target on DCB Bank from ₹163.73 to ₹180.38, citing updated assumptions that combine a similar discount rate with slightly adjusted revenue growth, a higher profit margin, and a marginally lower future P/E multiple. What's in the News The board has recommended a dividend of ₹1.45 per equity share of face value ₹10 for the year ended March 31, 2026, subject to shareholder and other required approvals, with payment to follow within the prescribed timeline after approval (Key Developments).

news.title: Now 22% undervalued after recent price drop
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 6.5% to ₹181. The fair value is estimated to be ₹232, however this is not to be taken as a buy recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has grown by 14% over the last 3 years. Earnings per share has grown by 14%. For the next 3 years, revenue is forecast to grow by 19% per annum. Earnings are also forecast to grow by 18% per annum over the same time period.

news.title: Price target increased by 7.6% to ₹228
news.body: Up from ₹212, the current price target is an average from 17 analysts. New target price is 20% above last closing price of ₹190. Stock is up 38% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹28.09 for next year compared to ₹23.01 last year.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹23.01 (vs ₹19.63 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹23.01 (up from ₹19.63 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹29.9b (up 13% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹7.32b (up 19% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 24% (up from 23% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 19% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 1.7% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 14% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 22% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Dcb Bank Limited Recommends Dividend for Year Ended March 31, 2026
news.body: DCB Bank Limited announced that the Board has recommended a dividend of INR 1.45 (Rupee One and Paise Forty-Five only) per Equity Share of face value INR 10 each of the Bank year ended March 31, 2026, subject To Approve the Shareholders at the ensuing Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the Bank and other requisite approvals, if any. The dividend will be paid/despatched within the prescribed time, post approval of the Shareholders. Record Date for same will be intimated separately to the Stock Exchanges in due course.
